name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Products Ltd (VOEPL)
tagline: Bharti-family-promoted OEM/ODM for white-goods/consumer electronics (ACs, water heaters, washing machines), recently migrated from BSE SME to the NSE main board - weak ROE, low interest coverage and rising debtor days temper the import-substitution tailwind.
business_overview: VOEPL is an OEM/ODM manufacturer supplying white goods and consumer electronics - air conditioners, water heaters, lighting products and semi-automatic washing machines - to brand customers, promoted by the Bharti family. It migrated from the BSE SME platform to the NSE main board effective July 1, 2026. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@ChintanParikh10), bullish, high conviction.
fundamentals_narrative: VOEPL sits in a real, ongoing India theme - import substitution / 'Make in India' for white-goods and consumer-electronics OEM/ODM manufacturing - but its own numbers are weak for a growth thesis: ROE of just ~5.38% (3-yr average) is well below what a compounder needs, and ROCE of ~13.41% is middling. Two specific cautions surfaced in the single search performed: low interest coverage and debtor days nearly doubling (24.0 to 41.3 days), both consistent with a low-margin, working-capital-intensive contract-manufacturing model rather than a business with real pricing power over its brand customers.
